editorial:
Imagine growing up in a city where the air feels heavy with secrets and the street corners are filled with danger. You follow two brothers in Dublin who get pulled into the messy world of republicanism and the war in the North. It is not just about politics, though; it is about that bond between siblings where you would do anything to protect your own blood, even if it means breaking the law. The vibe is gritty and raw, making you feel like you are walking right beside them through the rainy streets, wondering when everything is going to blow up in their faces.

What really hits home is the acting, as the chemistry between the brothers feels totally real. The pacing keeps you on your toes, though a few scenes drag a bit in the middle. If you love crime stories that focus on family and loyalty, you will love this one. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the gritty detail, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a heartbreaking choice that tests the brothers' loyalty. After a series of betrayals, one brother realizes that the cause they fought for does not actually care about them. In the final scenes, a violent confrontation breaks out that leaves one brother dead and the other shattered. It wraps up by showing that the cycle of violence only leads to loss, leaving the survivor alone with his guilt and a broken family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty crime dramas and stories about family loyalty.
